title: Page 6
content_zh:
戚家，京城内数一数二的富商，从事茶楼、镖局、布庄、钱庄四种买卖，各由戚家四位公子掌管打理，可以说是无人不知、无人不晓，在商界内的势力可是大得吓人。
既然家大业大，自然奴仆的需求量也就多，戚管家定期都会向奴仆贩子买回新人，补足府内不够的仆佣人数。
而她，草儿，就是在一个多月前新补进来的丫鬟。其实草儿看起来瘦瘦的，好像风一吹就会倒，做不了什么粗重工作，本来戚管家是不打算买下她的，但当时她一直用一种水汪汪像是快掉泪楚楚可怜的眼神看着他，让他莫名出现一种愧疚感，好像不买下她是什么天大的罪过一样。
就因为这莫名其妙的愧疚感，戚管家一时心软也顺便买下她，将一身脏污的她带回戚家，让她好好梳洗一番后，才发现原来她长得很不错、很有大家闺秀的气质，但这些只限于她静静的、不说话、不做事、没有其他动作的时候。
因为她……其实动作慢、呆呆的，是个迟钝的傻丫头！
「来了来了，抽签的时间到，丫鬟们都赶紧靠过来吧……」
奴仆们所住的后院里，戚管家此刻拿着一个大签筒，吆喝着所有丫鬟们赶紧靠过来，准备举行三个月一次的抽签。每个丫鬟一听到又要抽签，莫不出现惊恐的神色，好像抽签这件事是什么可怕至极的事情一样。
拿着扫把慢吞吞回到后院的草儿，困惑地看着这一幕，这是她进入戚家之后第一次遇到抽签的事情，所以她根本不懂，为什么那些姊妹们看起来好害怕，好像签筒会跑出一条毒蛇咬她们一口似的。
戚管家看着呆站在一旁的草儿，像是完全搞不清楚状况，马上喊道：「丫头，你还傻愣在那做什么？快过来抽签呀，抽完没事就可以继续去做你的事了。」
「喔。」她乖乖应答，拿着扫把慢慢靠近，原来抽完没事就可以继续去做自己的事，那些姊妹们到底在害怕什么？
她想不透，单纯的脑子没办法思考太复杂的事，要不然头会发疼，反正她只要照着戚管家的话做就对了。
丫鬟们排成长队，一个个轮流从戚管家的签筒里抽签，她们每个人都是一脸胆战心惊地伸手抽起一支签，之后便大大松一口气，欢天喜地地离开队伍，脚步轻快得简直快飞上天了。
「哈哈……没事了，我这三个月放心了。」
「谢天谢地，老天保佑，我没事了……」
「很好、很好，顺利逃过一劫！」
没过多久，排在草儿前头的丫鬟们都已经抽完签，换她面临最要紧的「生死关头」。
她也没有想太多，就学其他丫鬟一样，直接在签筒选一支签，然后慢慢抽起，就见白净的竹签下方被涂上红红的一条横线，很醒目、很刺眼，但她却不懂这是什么意思。
应该其他的签也都长这个样子吧？嗯，应该是这样子，没错。
「没事了……」任务完成，她也学其他的丫鬟转身离开队伍，脑袋里想的是她刚才扫到一半还没扫完的地。
「等等。」戚管家突然抓住她的肩膀，不让她走，脸色显得异常的凝重。「丫头，你有事。」

她眨眨眼，没想到戚管家这么厉害，连她事情还没做完都知道。「是呀，我花园里的地还有一大半没扫，所以我现在要继续去扫地了。」
「嗄？唉……」他感到挫败地大叹了口气，总觉得每次和她说话都像鸡同鸭讲。「不是这个事，而是你……抽到签王了。」
「呃？签王？」什么是签王？
排在草儿后面一位的丫鬟惊呼出声，兴奋地说：「签王出现了？太好了太好了，咱们排后头的不必抽了，这一次的签王已经出现啦！」
「哈哈……抽签结束了，这一次的签王已经出现啦！」
后头的丫鬟们开心地赶紧传递消息，一个传一个，让其他丫鬟也大大松了一口气，因为签筒里只会有一支签王，只要签王出现，她们就不必再抽了。
「丫头，你……你是这一次的签王，未来的这三个月，你可得要……辛苦一点了。」戚管家忍不住叹了再叹，让这个傻乎乎的丫头抽中签王，会不会对她太残忍了一点，她真的应付得来吗？
但就算应付不来也得硬着头皮去应付，毕竟这就是规矩，要是在她身上坏了规矩，他往后怎么管理这些丫鬟，丫鬟们绝对不会信服的。
草儿还是不懂到底发生了什么事，只好睁着无辜的双眼，困惑地问：「戚管家，签王要干什么，是必须要扫更多更多的地吗？」
她一进到戚家里，笨手笨脚的什么都不会，做什么事情都会搞砸，所以戚管家才把她派去做最简单的扫地工作，扫了一个多月，她已经扫出一些心得出来，动作也变快了，所以如果是要扫更多的地，她有信心，自己绝对可以做得来的。
「从明天开始，你不必再扫地了，你的工作会换成别的。」
「呃？换别的？换什么？」那她的扫地工作怎么办？她好不容易才终于扫出心得的说……
「换成三公子院落里的专属贴身丫鬟。」
「喔。」她傻傻地应着，这有比扫地还简单吗？
戚管家拍拍她的肩，语重心长地说：「丫头，三个月的时间很快就会过去的，所以你一定要忍耐，好吗？」
忍耐什么？她不解。
「相信我，三公子绝对不会吃人，他心肠很好的，真的。」
他是没饭吃所以才吃人吗？对于戚管家说的话，她愈来愈疑惑了。
「这绝对不是一件人人避之唯恐不及的苦差事，而是件好差事，真的！」戚管家越解释越激动，但听起来却总像是欲盖弥彰。
那你为什么眉越皱越难看？

「总而言之，言而总之，唉……丫头，这三个月保重了……」戚管家再度大叹出声，希望这个傻乎乎的丫头绝对要撑住，不要被吓得变更傻呀！
谁教他们戚家有这样的麻烦主子存在，这也不是他愿意的，会一个个轮流把丫鬟给「推入火坑」，他也是万不得已的呀！
第1章(1)
直到后来，经由戚管家好心兼努力的解释过后，草儿才终于明白到底发生了什么事。
原来他们戚家的三公子每三个月就会换一次院里的专属贴身丫鬟，其他公子如果要换贴身丫鬟，可是大家都抢着要做，唯独三公子丫鬟缘不好，没有丫鬟肯主动调过去，戚管家只好使出终极大绝招——抽签定生死。
听说是因为三公子有起床气，脾气不好，才会惹得丫鬟们受不了，待没多久就纷纷求去，为防丫鬟们继续三天两头就说不干了，戚家才会订下这样的规矩，让三公子身旁的丫鬟每三个月就固定换一次，并且在这段时间内提高贴身丫鬟的薪饷一倍，要她们好好忍耐，吃苦当作吃补，三个月很快就会过去的。
但……起床气很可怕吗？她想像不出来，只好不想了，反正她只要照着戚管家的吩咐，乖乖调过去做事就对。
一大清早，草儿端了一盆温水往三公子的院落走去，正式开始她的贴身丫鬟工作，一路走来，看到她的仆役们都会对她摇头叹气，好像她这一路走过去是要赴死一样。
「唉，可怜呀！」
「不知道她撑不撑得过第一天呀……」
因为类似的「惨案」都会发生在新的贴身丫鬟上工的第一天，每个丫鬟都会又哭又尖叫的冲出房，吓得几乎快去掉半条命，没有一个例外，他们只怕这个傻乎乎的丫头会更惨，三魂七魄被吓得只剩一魂一魄，那就可怜喽。
content_en:
The Qi family, one of the most wealthy businessmen in the capital, is engaged in four types of businesses: teahouses, escort agencies, cloth shops, and banks. Each of them is managed by the four young masters of the Qi family. It can be said that everyone knows about it, and its influence in the business world is terrifying.
Since the family has a large business, the demand for servants is naturally high. Butler Qi regularly buys new servants from slave traders to make up for the insufficient number of servants in the house.
And she, Cao'er, was the new maid who was hired more than a month ago. In fact, Cao'er looked thin and skinny, as if she would fall over if the wind blew, and she couldn't do any heavy work. Originally, Butler Qi didn't plan to buy her, but at that time she kept looking at him with a watery, pitiful look that looked like she was about to cry, which made him feel an inexplicable guilt, as if not buying her was some huge sin.
Because of this inexplicable feeling of guilt, Butler Qi felt soft-hearted and bought her by the way. He took her to Qi's house, all dirty, and after letting her freshen up, he discovered that she was very good-looking and had the air of a lady, but this was only when she was quiet, not talking, not doing anything, and not doing anything else.
Because she... is actually slow and dull, a dull and stupid girl!
"Come on, come on, it's time to draw lots, maids, hurry up and come over..."
In the backyard where the slaves lived, Butler Qi was holding a big lottery tube and yelling at all the maids to come closer and prepare to hold the lottery every three months. When every maid heard that they were about to draw lots, they all looked horrified, as if drawing lots was something extremely terrifying.
Cao'er slowly returned to the backyard with a broom and looked at this scene in confusion. This was the first time she encountered lottery after entering Qi's house, so she didn't understand why the sisters looked so scared, as if a poisonous snake would come out of the lottery tube and bite them.
Butler Qi looked at Cao'er who was standing aside blankly, as if he didn't understand the situation at all, and immediately shouted: "Girl, what are you doing there stupidly? Come over and draw lots. After drawing lots, you can continue to do your thing."
"Oh." She responded obediently, holding the broom and approaching slowly. It turned out that after she was done, she could continue to do her own thing. What on earth were those sisters afraid of?
She couldn't think clearly. Her simple brain couldn't think about too complicated things, otherwise her head would hurt. Anyway, she just had to do what Butler Qi said.
The maids lined up in a long queue, and one by one they took turns to draw lots from Butler Qi's lottery box. Each of them stretched out their hand to draw a lot with a fearful look on their face, and then they breathed a sigh of relief and left the queue happily, their steps so brisk that they almost flew into the sky.
"Haha...it's okay. I feel relieved these past three months."
"Thank God, God bless me, I'm fine..."
"Very good, well escaped!"
Not long after, the maids in front of Cao'er had all drawn lots, and she faced the most important "life and death moment."
She didn't think too much, just like other maids, she directly selected a lottery ticket in the tube, and then slowly pulled it out. She saw a red horizontal line painted on the bottom of the white bamboo stick, which was very eye-catching and dazzling, but she didn't understand what it meant.
The other signatures should all look like this, right? Well, that's how it should be, yes.
"It's okay..." After the task was completed, she followed the example of the other maids and turned around to leave the team. What she was thinking about was the floor she had just finished sweeping halfway through.
"Wait a minute." Butler Qi suddenly grabbed her shoulders and refused to let her go. His face looked unusually solemn. "Girl, there's something wrong with you."
She blinked. She didn't expect that Butler Qi was so powerful and knew that she hadn't finished her work yet. "Yes, I still have more than half of my garden to sweep, so I'm going to continue sweeping now."
"Huh? Sigh..." He sighed in frustration, always feeling that every time he met herThey talk like a chicken talking to a duck. "It's not about this, it's about you... getting the lottery winner."
"Huh? King of Lottery?" What is King of Lottery?
The maid who was behind Cao'er exclaimed and said excitedly: "The lottery king has appeared? Great, great, we at the back don't have to draw. This time the lottery king has appeared!"
"Haha... the lottery is over, and this time the lottery winner has appeared!"
The maids at the back happily passed on the news, one by one, and the other maids also breathed a sigh of relief, because there would only be one lottery king in the lottery tube, and as long as the lottery king appeared, they did not have to draw anymore.
"Girl, you... you are the winner of the lot this time. In the next three months, you have to... work harder." Butler Qi couldn't help but sigh again and again. Would it be too cruel to let this silly girl win the lottery? Can she really handle it?
But even if he can't cope with it, he still has to deal with it. After all, these are the rules. If she breaks the rules, how will he manage these maids in the future? The maids will never be convinced.
Cao'er still didn't understand what was going on, so he could only open his innocent eyes and asked in confusion: "Steward Qi, what do you want to sign for the king? Do you have to sweep more and more land?"
As soon as she entered Qi's house, she was clumsy and knew nothing and would mess up everything she did, so housekeeper Qi sent her to do the simplest sweeping job. After sweeping for more than a month, she had gained some ideas and her movements became faster, so if she needed to sweep more floors, she was confident that she could definitely do it.
"Starting from tomorrow, you don't have to sweep the floor anymore, your job will be changed to something else."
"Huh? Change to something else? Change to what?" What about her sweeping job? With great difficulty, she finally figured out her feelings and said...
"Change into the exclusive personal maid in the Third Young Master's courtyard."
"Oh." She responded innocently. Is this simpler than sweeping the floor?
Butler Qi patted her shoulder and said sincerely, "Girl, three months will pass quickly, so you must be patient, okay?"
What to endure? She didn't understand.
"Believe me, Third Young Master will never eat people. He has a good heart, really."
Did he eat people because he had no food to eat? She became more and more confused about what Butler Qi said.
"This is definitely not a chore that everyone avoids, but a good job, really!" Butler Qi became more and more excited as he explained, but it always sounded like he was trying to cover up the truth.
Then why do you frown and look uglier?
"All in all, all in all, oh...girl, take care of yourself these three months..." Housekeeper Qi sighed loudly again, hoping that this silly girl would definitely hold on and not be scared to the point of becoming even stupider!
Who taught them that the Qi family has such a troublesome master? This is not what he wants. He will take turns to "push the maids into the fire pit" one by one. He has no choice but to do so!
Chapter 1(1)
It was not until later, after Butler Qi's kind and diligent explanation, that Cao'er finally understood what had happened.
It turns out that the third young master of the Qi family will change his exclusive personal maid in the courtyard every three months. If the other young masters want to change their personal maids, everyone is rushing to do it. Only the third young master has a bad relationship with the maids, and no maid is willing to take the initiative to transfer him. Butler Qi has to resort to the ultimate trick - draw lots to determine life and death.
I heard that it was because the third young master was angry when he got up and had a bad temper that the maids couldn't bear it, and they all begged him to leave after a short time. In order to prevent the maids from quitting every day, the Qi family made such a rule. , let the maids next to the Third Young Master be replaced every three months, and double the salary of the personal maids during this period, and ask them to be patient and take hardship as a supplement, and the three months will pass quickly.
But...is it terrible to wake up angry? She can't imagineCome on, I have no choice but to think about it. Anyway, she just needs to follow Butler Qi's instructions and be transferred to do things.
Early in the morning, Cao'er took a basin of warm water and walked to the third son's courtyard to officially start her work as a personal maid. Along the way, the servants who saw her would shake their heads and sigh at her, as if she was going to die by walking this way.
"Oh, how pitiful!"
"I wonder if she can survive the first day..."
Because a similar "tragedy" would happen on the first day of the new personal maid's work. Each maid would rush out of the room crying and screaming, almost losing half of her life in fear, without exception. They were only afraid that this silly girl would be even worse. It would be pitiful for the three souls and seven souls to be frightened until only one soul was left.
